home.heading: Wikis
home.tagline: Obsidian-flavoured Markdown folders on this machine, rendered read-only.
home.emptyText: Add a wiki in Settings. No restart needed.
home.errorTitle: The config file has a problem
home.errorKeep: The last good list stays in use until it is fixed.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

unavailableView.heading: This page is unavailable
unavailableView.description: It doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

emptyWiki.heading: This wiki has no pages yet
emptyWiki.description: Pages appear here as soon as they are added to the wiki.

pdf.chromeHint: For the best PDF, use Chrome.

editor.heading: Heading {level}
editor.imageHint: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or SVG, up to 10 MB. It's saved in the wiki's assets folder.
editor.imageAddressHint: A web address, or a path in this wiki.
editor.imageAltHint: Describe the image for people who can't see it.
editor.imageMissing: Add a file or an image address.
editor.imageUploadFailed: The image couldn't be uploaded. Try again.

edit.sourceOnly: The editor can't read some of this page's Markdown, so it opens as source.
edit.conflict: This page changed on disk after you opened it, so nothing was saved. Copy your changes, then reload.
edit.failed: The page couldn't be saved. Try again.
edit.readOnly: Editing is turned off for this app.
edit.rewritten: Saved. The editor couldn't match this page block by block, so it rewrote the page's formatting. Check the change in git before you commit.

search.failed: Search is unavailable. Reload the page to try again, or browse the pages in the sidebar.
search.emptyText: Search looks at page titles, headings and text. Try fewer or different words, or browse the pages in the sidebar.

staleNotice.message: Content may be out of date, last updated {time} UTC.

errorPage.heading: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: This page couldn't be shown. Try again, or go back to your wikis.

retryView.heading: Temporarily unavailable
retryView.description: We can't reach this wiki's source right now. Try again in a moment.

mermaid.caption: Diagram source (drawing needs JavaScript)
mermaid.drawError: This diagram could not be drawn.

wikilinks.unavailableTooltip: This link has no target in this wiki.
wikilinks.embedCycle: This note is already shown above, so it is not embedded again.
wikilinks.embedDepth: Embedding stops here: too many levels.
wikilinks.embedBudget: Embedding stops here: this page embeds too many notes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tagline: Which wikis this app reads, and how they print.

wikis.heading: Wikis
wikis.addHint: The full path of a folder on this computer, or a path starting with ~.
wikis.empty: No wikis yet. Add one above.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.text: {name} leaves the wiki list and the home page. The folder on disk is not touched.

env.title: The wiki list comes from WIKI_DIRS

print.label: Print a heading made from the file name
print.hint: Shown on printed pages that have no title of their own.

server.portHint: Applies the next time the app starts.
